verses.original: וְאֵ֤לֶּה הָיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י דָויִ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֽוֹלַד־ ל֖וֹ בְּחֶבְר֑וֹן הַבְּכ֣וֹר׀ אַמְנֹ֗ן לַאֲחִינֹ֙עַם֙ הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֔ית שֵׁנִי֙ דָּנִיֵּ֔אל לַאֲבִיגַ֖יִל הַֽכַּרְמְלִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh hā·yū bə·nê ḏå̄·w·yiḏ ’ă·šer nō·w·laḏ- lōw bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn hab·bə·ḵō·wr ’am·nōn la·’ă·ḥî·nō·‘am hay·yiz·rə·‘ê·lîṯ šê·nî dā·nî·yêl la·’ă·ḇî·ḡa·yil hak·kar·mə·lîṯ
verses.literal: These were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron The firstborn was Amnon by Ahinoam of Jezreel the second was Daniel by Abigail of Carmel

verses.original: הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ לְאַבְשָׁל֣וֹם בֶּֽן־ מַעֲכָ֔ה בַּת־ תַּלְמַ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ גְּשׁ֑וּר הָרְבִיעִ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּ֥ה בֶן־ חַגִּֽית׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·li·šî lə·’aḇ·šā·lō·wm ben- ma·‘ă·ḵāh baṯ- tal·may me·leḵ gə·šūr hā·rə·ḇî·‘î ’ă·ḏō·nî·yāh ḇen- ḥag·gîṯ
verses.literal: the third was Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur the fourth was Adonijah the son of Haggith

verses.original: הַחֲמִישִׁ֥י שְׁפַטְיָ֖ה לַאֲבִיטָ֑ל הַשִּׁשִּׁ֥י יִתְרְעָ֖ם לְעֶגְלָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥă·mî·šî šə·p̄aṭ·yāh la·’ă·ḇî·ṭāl haš·šiš·šî yiṯ·rə·‘ām lə·‘eḡ·lāh ’iš·tōw
verses.literal: the fifth was Shephatiah by Abital and the sixth was Ithream by his wife Eglah

verses.original: שִׁשָּׁה֙ נֽוֹלַד־ ל֣וֹ בְחֶבְר֔וֹן וַיִּ֨מְלָךְ־ שָׁ֔ם שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: šiš·šāh nō·w·laḏ- lōw ḇə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn way·yim·lāḵ- šām še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm wə·šiš·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm ū·šə·lō·šîm wə·šā·lō·wōš šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: These six sons were born to David in Hebron where he reigned seven years and six months And David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three . . . years

verses.original: וְאֵ֥לֶּה נוּלְּדוּ־ ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑יִם שִׁ֠מְעָא וְשׁוֹבָ֞ב וְנָתָ֤ן וּשְׁלֹמֹה֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לְבַת־ שׁ֖וּעַ בַּת־ עַמִּיאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh nūl·lə·ḏū- lōw bî·rū·šā·lā·yim šim·ʿāʾ wə·šō·w·ḇāḇ wə·nā·ṯān ū·šə·lō·mōh ’ar·bā·‘āh lə·ḇaṯ- šū·a‘ baṯ- ‘am·mî·’êl
verses.literal: and these sons were born to him in Jerusalem Shimea Shobab Nathan and Solomon These four were born to him by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel

verses.original: וְיִבְחָ֥ר וֶאֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע וֶאֱלִיפָֽלֶט׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiḇ·ḥār we·’ĕ·lî·šā·mā‘ we·’ĕ·lî·p̄ā·leṭ
verses.literal: David’s other sons were Ibhar Elishua Eliphelet

verses.original: וְנֹ֥גַהּ וְנֶ֖פֶג וְיָפִֽיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·ḡah wə·ne·p̄eḡ wə·yā·p̄î·a‘
verses.literal: Nogah Nepheg Japhia

verses.original: וֶאֱלִישָׁמָ֧ע וְאֶלְיָדָ֛ע וֶאֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט תִּשְׁעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: we·’ĕ·lî·šā·mā‘ wə·’el·yā·ḏā‘ we·’ĕ·lî·p̄e·leṭ tiš·‘āh
verses.literal: Elishama Eliada and Eliphelet nine in all

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד מִלְּבַ֥ד בְּֽנֵי־ פִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים וְתָמָ֥ר אֲחוֹתָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: kōl bə·nê ḏā·wîḏ mil·lə·ḇaḏ bə·nê- p̄î·laḡ·šîm wə·ṯā·mār ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: These were all the sons of David besides the sons by his concubines And Tamar was their sister

verses.original: וּבֶן־ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה רְחַבְעָ֑ם אֲבִיָּ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ אָסָ֥א בְנ֖וֹ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇen- šə·lō·mōh rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām ’ă·ḇî·yāh ḇə·nōw ’ā·sā ḇə·nōw yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ bə·nōw
verses.literal: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam Abijah was his son Asa his son Jehoshaphat his son

verses.original: יוֹרָ֥ם בְּנ֛וֹ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ יוֹאָ֥שׁ בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·rām bə·nōw ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū ḇə·nōw yō·w·’āš bə·nōw
verses.literal: Joram his son Ahaziah his son Joash his son

verses.original: אֲמַצְיָ֧הוּ בְנ֛וֹ עֲזַרְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ יוֹתָ֥ם בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·maṣ·yā·hū ḇə·nōw ‘ă·zar·yāh ḇə·nōw yō·w·ṯām bə·nōw
verses.literal: Amaziah his son Azariah his son Jotham his son

verses.original: אָחָ֥ז בְּנ֛וֹ חִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḥāz bə·nōw ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ḇə·nōw mə·naš·šeh ḇə·nōw
verses.literal: Ahaz his son Hezekiah his son Manasseh his son

verses.original: אָמ֥וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mō·wn bə·nōw yō·šî·yā·hū ḇə·nōw
verses.literal: Amon his son and Josiah his son

verses.original: וּבְנֵי֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֔הוּ הַבְּכוֹר֙ יוֹחָנָ֔ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖י יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ הָרְבִיעִ֖י שַׁלּֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yō·šî·yā·hū hab·bə·ḵō·wr yō·w·ḥā·nān haš·šê·nî yə·hō·w·yā·qîm haš·šə·li·šî ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū hā·rə·ḇî·‘î šal·lūm
verses.literal: The sons of Josiah Johanan was the firstborn Jehoiakim the second Zedekiah the third and Shallum the fourth

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים יְכָנְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yə·hō·w·yā·qîm yə·ḵā·nə·yāh ḇə·nōw ṣiḏ·qî·yāh ḇə·nōw
verses.literal: The successors of Jehoiakim Jeconiah his son and Zedekiah

verses.original: וּבְנֵי֙ יְכָנְיָ֣ה אַסִּ֔ר שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֖ל בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yə·ḵā·nə·yāh ’as·sir šə·’al·tî·’êl bə·nōw
verses.literal: The descendants of Jeconiah the captive Shealtiel his son

verses.original: וּמַלְכִּירָ֥ם וּפְדָיָ֖ה וְשֶׁנְאַצַּ֑ר יְקַמְיָ֥ה הוֹשָׁמָ֖ע וּנְדַבְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mal·kî·rām ū·p̄ə·ḏā·yāh wə·šen·’aṣ·ṣar yə·qam·yāh hō·wō·šā·mā‘ ū·nə·ḏaḇ·yāh
verses.literal: Malchiram Pedaiah Shenazzar Jekamiah Hoshama and Nedabiah

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י פְדָיָ֔ה זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל וְשִׁמְעִ֑י וּבֶן־ זְרֻבָּבֶל֙ מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם וַחֲנַנְיָ֔ה וּשְׁלֹמִ֖ית אֲחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê p̄ə·ḏā·yāh zə·rub·bā·ḇel wə·šim·‘î ū·ḇen- zə·rub·bā·ḇel mə·šul·lām wa·ḥă·nan·yāh ū·šə·lō·mîṯ ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: The sons of Pedaiah Zerubbabel and Shimei The children of Zerubbabel Meshullam and Hananiah their sister Shelomith

verses.original: וַחֲשֻׁבָ֡ה וָ֠אֹהֶל וּבֶרֶכְיָ֧ה וַֽחֲסַדְיָ֛ה י֥וּשַׁב חֶ֖סֶד חָמֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·šu·ḇāh wā·’ō·hel ū·ḇe·reḵ·yāh wa·ḥă·saḏ·yāh yū·šaḇ ḥe·seḏ ḥā·mêš
verses.literal: and five others Hashubah Ohel Berechiah Hasadiah and Jushab-hesed

verses.original: וּבֶן־ חֲנַנְיָ֖ה פְּלַטְיָ֣ה וִישַֽׁעְיָ֑ה בְּנֵ֤י רְפָיָה֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַרְנָ֔ן בְּנֵ֥י עֹבַדְיָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇen- ḥă·nan·yāh pə·laṭ·yāh wî·ša‘·yāh bə·nê rə·p̄ā·yāh bə·nê ’ar·nān bə·nê ‘ō·ḇaḏ·yāh bə·nê šə·ḵan·yāh
verses.literal: The descendants of Hananiah Pelatiah Jeshaiah and the sons of Rephaiah . . . of Arnan . . . of Obadiah and of Shecaniah

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָ֖ה שְׁמַעְיָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֣י שְׁמַעְיָ֗ה חַטּ֡וּשׁ וְ֠יִגְאָל וּבָרִ֧יחַ וּנְעַרְיָ֛ה וְשָׁפָ֖ט שִׁשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê šə·ḵan·yāh šə·ma‘·yāh ū·ḇə·nê šə·ma‘·yāh ḥaṭ·ṭūš wə·yiḡ·’āl ū·ḇā·rî·aḥ ū·nə·‘ar·yāh wə·šā·p̄āṭ šiš·šāh
verses.literal: The six descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons Hattush Igal Bariah Neariah and Shaphat

verses.original: וּבֶן־ נְעַרְיָ֗ה אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֧י וְחִזְקִיָּ֛ה וְעַזְרִיקָ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇen- nə·‘ar·yāh ’el·yō·w·‘ê·nay wə·ḥiz·qî·yāh wə·‘az·rî·qām šə·lō·šāh
verses.literal: The sons of Neariah Elioenai Hizkiah and Azrikam three in all

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֗י הֹדַיְוָהוּ וְאֶלְיָשִׁ֡יב וּפְלָיָ֡ה וְ֠עַקּוּב וְיוֹחָנָ֧ן וּדְלָיָ֛ה וַעֲנָ֖נִי שִׁבְעָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ’el·yō·w·‘ê·nay hō·ḏay·wå̄·hū wə·’el·yā·šîḇ ū·p̄ə·lā·yāh wə·‘aq·qūḇ wə·yō·w·ḥā·nān ū·ḏə·lā·yāh wa·‘ă·nā·nî šiḇ·‘āh
verses.literal: The sons of Elioenai Hodaviah Eliashib Pelaiah Akkub Johanan Delaiah and Anani seven in all
